customManagers.description: Track the Bun versions in the CI test matrix, one per supported line, marked `# renovate: bun`
Track npm CLIs pinned inline in workflow run blocks

packageRules.description: tests/deno/deno.json imports npm packages unversioned, so tests/deno/deno.lock is their only pin. Update the lock in place, so a dependency's Deno lock entry lands in the same branch as its package.json bump instead of waiting for lock-file maintenance.
Each CI matrix entry stands for one supported Bun line, so it takes patches only. Moving an entry to a newer line would silently drop the older line from CI; a new line is added by hand.
One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps, not one per action per digest
One PR for image digest refreshes

Hold TypeScript 7: tsup's d.ts build is broken on it (rollup-plugin-dts crash in tsup#1405, TS5101 baseUrl in tsup#1388/#1390), and both packages set dts: true. Revisit when TS 7.1 is stable and those are released.

OpenFGA is the conformance oracle, not just a service: write-gate-causes.json, the README and source comments are measured against one tag, and check:write-gate-causes fails while compose.yaml runs another. A bump means re-measuring, not merging.
prBodyNotes: Bumping OpenFGA moves the conformance oracle: re-run the suite against it, update the tag and SHA in `packages/core/write-gate-causes.json` and the `measured on vX` claims, and point `.openfga_repo` at the new tag before merging.
